(NASDAQ: MSLE, TSX: MSCL), a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing potentially life-improving medicines to treat degenerative muscle disorders, today announced that, following feedback from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), it has selected change in vastus lateralis fat fraction measured by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) as the primary efficacy endpoint in the BASECAMP Phase 2 clinical study in boys ages 7, 8 or 9 with Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD). articles.title: Satellos Changes Primary Efficacy Endpoint in BASECAMP Phase 2 Pediatric Trial to MRI-Measured Fat Fraction Following FDA Feedback

articles.summary: Company to host a conference call and audio webcast tomorrow at 8:00 a.m. ET TORONTO, Nov. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Satellos Bioscience Inc. (NASDAQ: MSLE, TSX: MSCL), a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing potentially life-improving medicines to treat degenerative muscle disorders, today announced that it will host a conference call and audio webcast at 8:00 a.m. ET on Friday, Nov. 6, 2026, to provide an update on the clinical and regulatory strategy for BASECAMP, the Company’s Phase 2 pediatric study in boys ages 7, 8 or 9 with Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD). The call will feature remarks from Satellos Co-founder and Chief Executive Officer Frank Gleeson and Chief Medical Officer Wildon Farwell, M.D. A live webcast of the conference call and accompanying slides will be available on the Events and Presentations page of the Investors section of the Company’s website. A replay will be available following the presentation. Conference Call Details Domestic:
articles.title: Satellos to Host Investor Call to Provide an Update on Clinical and Regulatory Strategy for the BASECAMP Phase 2 Pediatric Study
